findings.reason: the repair node's only quantitative target is this displacement; naming the probe step makes §3(1) unfalsifiable at the base and naming the correction step makes its size a recorded per-case quantity, so the section must state which it means.
findings.text: §2(1) brackets "the perturbation size the class's response step uses" and §2(3)/§3(1) displace by "±the inverse class's response step", but the inverse class (`MagneticsFit`) has two different step quantities and no "response step": a finite-difference probe of `difference_step = 1e-4` relative to `max(|coefficient|, 1)` (`nova/equilibrium/magnetics_fit.py:195,246`) and the data-dependent, line-searched Gauss–Newton candidate `coefficients + fraction * correction` (`magnetics_fit.py:269`). The class refuses any forward evaluation that does not qualify (`magnetics_fit.py:163-170`), so the ±1e-4 probe states necessarily qualify at the base revision or the fit could not have produced the 1 % row replay §0 cites; under that reading §3(1)'s displaced arms pass unchanged on unfixed code and its repair has no endpoint to prove, while under the correction reading the displacement is set by the case's own data residual and must be recorded per case rather than cited as a class constant — the direction is equally unresolved, since the class probes along coordinate axes but takes one combined correction direction

findings.reason: a worker cannot produce the TCV/ITER record without inventing the neighbourhood norm, the search set and the meaning of "stage", and an invented measure is not comparable to the §2 verdict the plan prints beside it.
findings.text: §2(2) asks the record to state "whether any state within 1 % of the stored coefficients qualifies when started from the stored flux map" and "the stage at which qualification is first lost", yet a 1 % ball in coefficient space is a continuum with no norm (relative sup, Euclidean, per-family) and no recorded search set, and "stage" names no scale (solve iteration, continuation displacement, coefficient index), so neither quantity is measurable as written and the answer recorded for TCV and ITER cannot be checked; this also contradicts §2's own preamble at line 85-87 ("It makes no claim about whether an unreached state exists"), which is the same existential claim in another form
